exercises.title: 7. Czarnikow context: fill in the blanks

items.prompt: British caution is often ___ as slowness; the reality is more subtle.
Consensus is not a committee; caution is not ___.
A long pause before a decision is not ___ — it is judgement at work.
Every choice they made was ___, not accidental.
items.hintAfterError: Depois de 'was' e em paralelo com 'accidental', a lacuna pede um adjetivo.

items.prompt: The best executives treat the firm as an ___ to protect, not an asset to strip.
Profit taken at the expense of the next decade is simply a ___.
Only once all the ___ had been weighed did the board commit.
No long-serving leader would ___ a decade of trust for one good quarter.
Their style was quiet, ___ and consistent — never flashy.
They were ___ but never late; patient but never passive.
items.hintAfterError: O paralelismo pede um contraste com 'never late': alguém que não tem pressa.
